full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioner having placed before us the impugned judgment of the High Court Division as well as the judgments of the Courts below, submitted that the plaintiff failed to prove his exclusive possession in the suit land and this aspect has been over looked by the trial Court as well as by the High Court Division and as such the impugned judgment of the High Court Division is liable to be set aside.
